column1: # The build register. One row per image produced; the schema and the reasoning
# are docs/project/BUILDS.md, and tools/builds.sh is what writes and validates
# It holds no rows. Every one of the twelve it held was removed at the project
# owner's direction on 2026-09-13, together with every archived image, and
# nothing is recorded here again until `Oxys 1 Alpha` — which docs/project/PLAN.md
# fixes at sub-task 8.7. The machinery is untouched: `make build-record` still
# works and would append row 1 the moment it is run.
# **Numbering restarts at 1**, by the owner's decision. A number issued before
# the clearing and a number issued after it are therefore different images, and
# what tells them apart is the date in the row — not the number. Every document
# that cited a number as a way of pointing at an image has stopped doing so;
# docs/project/TESTING-RECORD.md, which is an account of runs and is not edited
# after the fact, says so at its head.
